errors.evidence: The vertical axis is labeled “标题长度” (Title Length), not “频数” (Frequency). The frequency (number of poems) is represented on the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: 范围从 0 到 50，刻度间隔为 5，始于 0 终于 50
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is a categorical axis representing discrete title lengths (e.g., 1, 3, 5, 7, etc.), not a continuous numerical axis with a range from 0 to 50 and intervals of 5.

errors.text_span: 最短的标题长度 1 对应于频数为 1，标题长度为 2 对应于频数为 1，标题长度为 3 对应于频数为 1，标题长度为 4 对应于频数为 2，标题长度为 5 对应于频数为 4，标题长度为 13 对应于频数为 13，标题长度为 15 对应于频数为 22，标题长度为 22 对应于频数为 32，标题长度为 32 对应于频数为 38，标题长度为 39 对应于频数为 60，标题长度为 69 对应于频数为 69。
errors.evidence: This entire section incorrectly maps the title lengths (y-axis categories) to the number of poems (x-axis values). For example, it states '标题长度 1 对应于频数为 1' when the chart shows it corresponds to 69 poems. Similarly, '标题长度为 3 对应于频数为 1' is incorrect; the chart shows it corresponds to 60 poems. The mapping appears to be completely scrambled and hallucinates several data points (e.g., title length 2).

errors.text_span: 标题长度为 2 对应于频数为 1
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a bar for a title length of 2.

The description fails to mention that each bar has a data label at its end indicating the exact number of poems. It also misses describing the relationship between the y-axis category labels and their corresponding bars and values, which is the primary information in the chart.

errors.text_span: 每个条形都置于相应的文本标签之上
errors.evidence: This mischaracterizes the position of the data labels. The text labels showing the number of poems are placed at the end (right side) of each horizontal bar, not below them.

errors.text_span: 图表没有图例，也没有在视觉元素上或附近的注释/文本标签。
errors.evidence: This statement is false. While there is no legend, the chart clearly has text labels (data labels) at the end of each bar indicating the exact count, which are a form of annotation on a visual element.
